name: ytms-lyrics-sync
description: Synced lyrics for YouTube Music (Chrome + Firefox extension)

scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --target firefox-desktop
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename ytms-lyrics-sync-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename ytms-lyrics-sync-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
